Description.Scope of Services:
The City of Richmond is requesting proposals from qualified firms to provide comprehensive interior and exterior painting services for designated City-owned facilities. The purpose of this Request for Proposals (RFP) is to ensure that facilities are maintained in a clean, safe, and professional condition consistent with best management practices, California building standards, and industry specifications.

This RFP describes the project, the required scope of services, the consultant selection process, and the minimum information that must be included in the proposal. Failure to submit information in accordance with the RFP requirements and procedures may be cause for disqualification.

The City intends to establish an on-call list of qualified painting contractors through this solicitation. The resulting contract(s) will be for a term of three (3) years, with two (2) optional one-year extensions that may be exercised upon mutual agreement of both parties. The annual not-to-exceed amount is $200,000 per year, subject to budget appropriation and satisfactory performance.
